//: Watches the runbook markdown and schema.sql as well as the TypeScript,
because both are inputs: the knowledge base indexes the .md files at
startup, so editing a runbook changes what the agent retrieves.
Test files are ignored - `pnpm test:watch` is the loop for those, and
having the demo restart every time a test is edited is just noise.
The delay stops a multi-file save from triggering three runs. The demo
takes about a second, so restarting mid-edit wastes more than it costs.
